Build a managed Promotions system for the first-month-free promo, in worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-pricing (branch feature/pricing-cleanup — it already has the first-month-free promo + the money fix). Do NOT deploy, do NOT run prisma commands (verify with `npx tsc --noEmit`; node_modules symlinked; NEVER prisma generate). Commit when done; report per-part + a clear note on the atomic redemption logic (I will review that part personally — money-critical).

STUDY the exact patterns to mirror:
- lib/order.ts `claimOrderCoupon` (~323) — the ATOMIC redemption claim used by coupons: it does a conditional `updateMany`/insert guarded by `@@unique` constraints inside the order tx and throws if already claimed. Read how placeOrder calls it and how the quote/charge is computed (computeQuote ~185-276, the first-month-free credit at ~214).
- prisma/schema.prisma `CouponRedemption` (~711): `@@unique([couponId,userId])` + `@@unique([couponId,ipHash])`, `ipHash` nullable. lib/actions-growth.ts (~56) for how the client IP is read via `headers()` + hashed.
- lib/promotions.ts (FIRST_MONTH_FREE, `firstMonthFree` flag, currentPromo).
- The 4 order flows that apply the promo: VPS `placeOrder`/`payAndDeploy`, hosting `orderHostingAccount` (lib/actions-hosting.ts), email `subscribeEmail`/`orderEmailHosting` (lib/actions-email-hosting.ts), and game orders (grep for the game order action). The renewal worker: worker/product-renewals.ts + lib/renewal-charge.ts.
- Admin page pattern: app/admin/coupons/page.tsx + its actions.

BUILD:
1. **Schema (additive):** `PromoRedemption { id, promoId String (="first-month-free"), userId, user relation, ipHash String?, serviceType String (VPS|HOSTING|EMAIL|GAME), campaign String @default(""), orderRef String? (the resulting server/account/subscription id, to track renewal), renewed Boolean @default(false), renewedAt DateTime?, chargedCents Int, createdAt } with @@unique([promoId,userId]) + @@unique([promoId,ipHash]) + @@index([promoId]) + @@index([campaign])`. Also a Setting-backed toggle `first_month_free_enabled` (default true) + configurable caps are FIXED at 1/account + 1/IP (owner decision) — enforce via the two unique constraints, don't over-engineer configurability.

2. **Atomic claim** (mirror claimOrderCoupon): a helper `claimFirstMonthFree(tx, {userId, ipHash, serviceType, campaign, orderRef})` that INSERTS the PromoRedemption; on a Prisma P2002 unique-violation (this user OR this IP already redeemed) it returns `{claimed:false}`, else `{claimed:true}`. It must run INSIDE the order's charge transaction. CRITICAL money rule: the first-month-free credit is applied ONLY if claimed===true. If the claim fails (already redeemed by account or IP) OR the promo is disabled by the setting, the customer is charged the FULL price (no free month) — the order still succeeds, just at full price. So each order flow must compute BOTH the free-month charge and the full charge and debit the one matching the claim result, atomically. Do NOT fail the order on a lost claim; just charge full. Get the client IP from headers() and hash it the same way the coupon path does.

3. **Wire into all 4 order flows** (VPS/hosting/email/game): claim in the charge tx; charge full if not claimed; record serviceType + campaign (campaign from a cookie set by the /go link, step 5) + orderRef (the created server/account id).

4. **Renewal stats:** in worker/product-renewals.ts (or renewal-charge), when a server/account whose orderRef has a PromoRedemption bills its SECOND term, set that redemption's `renewed=true, renewedAt`. So conversion = renewed/total.

5. **Ad-bound link:** a route `app/go/[slug]/route.ts` — for slug `first-month-free`, read `?c=<campaign>`, set a short-lived signed/plain cookie `nx_promo_campaign=<campaign>` (sanitize campaign to alnum-dash, ≤40), and 302-redirect to the order/signup entry (e.g. `/pricing` or `/vps`). The order flows read this cookie for the `campaign` field. (Ties into the Meta/Google pixel already built — the campaign tag flows to conversion attribution.)

6. **Admin Promotions page** `app/admin/promotions/page.tsx` (requireArea platform) + nav entry in lib/admin-groups.ts: show the promo (enabled toggle → sets `first_month_free_enabled`), the caps (1/account + 1/IP, stated), a per-campaign **ad-link generator** (input a campaign name → shows the `nxeon.cloud/go/first-month-free?c=<campaign>` link to copy), and **renewal stats**: total redemptions, redemptions by campaign, renewed count, conversion %, and revenue recovered (sum of renewed subscriptions' term charges — approximate from the plan price if exact is hard, and say so).

tsc clean, commit with a clear message, and in your report spell out EXACTLY how the atomic claim + charge-full-on-failure works in each of the 4 flows so I can verify no path grants a free month twice or races.

5	 * FIRST TERM is free, then the plan renews at its regular price. This replaced

7	 * intro discount, a fictional "20% off 3-year annual billing" band, and a
8	 * homepage annual toggle — which produced three different live prices for the

13	 * It is modelled as a 100%-off-first-term discount so every existing call site

Done. All parts built, `tsc --noEmit` clean, committed as `dfa9b64` on `feature/pricing-cleanup`. No deploy, no prisma commands run.

## What shipped, per part

**1. Schema (additive)** — `prisma/schema.prisma`: `PromoRedemption` with `@@unique([promoId,userId])` + `@@unique([promoId,ipHash])` (the fixed 1/account + 1/IP caps), `@@index([promoId])` + `@@index([campaign])`, and the `User.promoRedemptions` back-relation. Setting default `first_month_free_enabled: "true"` in `lib/settings.ts`. No cap config — the two uniques *are* the caps.

**2. Atomic claim** — `lib/promo-redemption.ts` (new). `claimFirstMonthFree(tx, …)` INSERTs the redemption; on Prisma **P2002** (this user OR this IP already redeemed) returns `{claimed:false}`, rethrows anything else. Helpers: `firstMonthFreeEnabled`, `firstMonthFreeEligible` (read-only pre-check), `setPromoOrderRef`, `markPromoRenewed`, `firstMonthCreditCents`, `promoCampaignFromCookie`/`sanitizeCampaign`, `promoStats`.

**3. All 4 order flows wired** (details below).

**4. Renewal stats** — `markPromoRenewed(tx, orderRef)` (idempotent `renewed:false` guard) fires inside the renewal charge tx: `worker/billing.ts` `commitRenewal` (VPS+game, covers both wallet and card renewals since both funnel through it), `worker/product-renewals.ts` `chargeEmailRenewal` + `chargeHostingRenewal`.

**5. Ad link** — `app/go/[slug]/route.ts`: sanitizes `?c=`, sets `nx_promo_campaign` cookie (3-day, alnum-dash ≤40), 302s to `/pricing`. Campaign also rides Stripe metadata through the card round-trip (`lib/stripe.ts`) so attribution survives the webhook (no cookies there).

**6. Admin page** — `app/admin/promotions/page.tsx` (`requireArea("platform")`) + `actions.ts` toggle + `components/admin/PromotionsControls.tsx` (toggle + copy-ready ad-link generator). Nav entry in `lib/admin-groups.ts`, area map in `lib/rbac.ts`. Shows caps, per-campaign redemptions/renewed/conversion, and **approximate** recovered revenue (one renewal term at list price — labelled as approximate on the page).

## The atomic claim + charge-full-on-failure, per flow (money-critical — please verify this)

The invariant everywhere: **the credit is applied only when `claim.claimed === true`**, and the claim is a conditional INSERT guarded by the two uniques *inside the debit tx*. Concurrency: if two orders race (same account, or same IP), exactly one INSERT wins; the loser gets P2002 → `claimed:false` → charged full. No path grants a free month twice.

- **Hosting / Email (`orderHostingAccount`, `orderEmailHosting`)** — pure wallet, single tx. Compute `fullCharge = plan.priceCents`, `promoCharge = 0`. `firstMonthFreeEligible` picks the balance gate only (so a $0-balance first-timer can sign up free; a repeat is gated at full). Inside the tx: if the promo is enabled, `claimFirstMonthFree`; on `claimed` debit `promoCharge` and record, else debit `fullCharge`. `setPromoOrderRef` stamps the account/subscription id. Existing "whole first term free" amount preserved — only made managed.

- **Game (`orderGameServer`)** — same shape; game had *no* promo before, so `promoCharge = fullCharge − firstMonthCreditCents(price, termMonths)` (one month of the flat term; single-month plan → $0). `termPromoPercent` stays 0 (game renews flat, no plan-delta proration).

- **VPS wallet path (`payAndDeploy` → `placeOrder(sold=null)`)** — `orderQuote` now respects the toggle and returns `promoCreditCents`. In `placeOrder`'s tx: `claimFirstMonthFree`; on `claimed` debit `chargeCents` (promo price), else **add the credit back → `chargeCents + promoCreditCents` = full**, clear the promo note, and record `termPromoPercent = 0` (so a later downgrade can't prorate out a discount nobody paid). A lost claim never fails the order — worst case it charges full and, if the wallet can't cover full, fails cleanly on `InsufficientBalanceError`. `setPromoOrderRef` stamps the server id.

- **VPS card path (`payAndDeploy` card leg → confirm/webhook → `placeOrder(sold=…)`)** — the free month is money that settles *up front* via Stripe, so it's screened *before* checkout: `payAndDeploy` runs `firstMonthFreeEligible`; if the customer already redeemed (or promo off) it **re-quotes at full** (`orderQuote(intent,{suppressPromo:true})`) so the card leg and stamped `sold` price are full. At fulfil, `placeOrder` still runs the atomic claim inside its tx, but a lost claim here is **swallowed** (keep the already-settled `sold` price, record nothing) — identical discipline to `claimOrderCoupon` on a paid order. So the everyday repeat-redemption is closed by the pre-check; only a genuine simultaneous-race slips through and is bounded to the one already-paid session, never a second recorded free month.

Two subtleties worth your eye: (a) empty IP hashes are normalized to `null` (`hashIp(...) || null`) so IP-less redemptions don't collide on the per-IP unique (NULLs are distinct); (b) `node_modules` is a symlink to prod and the Prisma client is stale, so all `promoRedemption` delegate access is behind one typed cast in `lib/promo-redemption.ts` — `tsc` is clean now, and runtime needs `prisma generate` + `db push` at your deploy (not run here).
